tasks.prompt: Which volumes in my Origin Cloud project are larger than 40 GiB, and which of those aren't attached to anything? Give me their ids and sizes.

checks.why: The agent lists the volumes of the user's project.
The agent reads the CLI's JSON output, not the table the profile asks for.
The unattached 500 GiB volume is named.
The unattached 50 GiB volume is named.
The attached 100 GiB volume is named.
Nothing is created, changed or deleted.

tasks.prompt: Create a 20 GiB Origin Cloud volume for the new reporting database.

checks.why: With no default project and two to choose from, the agent asks rather than picking one.
The agent asks which project to create it in.

tasks.prompt: The Postgres data volume vol-pgdata in Origin Cloud is almost full. Grow it to 250 GiB.

checks.why: The agent reads the volume before changing it.
Growing a volume can't be undone: the agent asks before it, rather than passing --yes.

checks.pattern: (?i)(never shrink|can.?not shrink|can.?t shrink|shrink back|can.?t be undone|cannot be undone|irreversible|one-way|permanent)
checks.why: The agent says the change can't be undone.
The agent says which instance holds the volume, whose file system must grow too.

tasks.prompt: We don't use the old FTP security group in Origin Cloud any more. Remove it.

checks.why: The agent finds the group by reading the security groups.
A delete needs the user's yes for that resource: the agent asks rather than passing --yes.
The agent names the group it would delete.

tasks.prompt: I started creating a volume for the reports service with --no-wait, and origin printed the operation projects/shop-prod/zones/eu-central1-az1/operations/op-7f3a. Attach the volume to the instance web-1 as soon as it's ready.

checks.why: The agent waits on the operation.
The agent attaches the volume only once its operation is done, not while it is still being created.
The volume ends up attached to web-1.

tasks.prompt: Launch a small Debian 12 instance named worker-1 in my Origin Cloud project. I need to SSH into it from our office network 198.51.100.0/24 over a public IPv4 address. Use our ops key pair, and tell me the address once it's up.

checks.why: The project's VPC already reaches the internet: the agent reads the network and builds on it rather than creating a new one.
SSH is admitted from the office network.
The instance's interface is put in a security group; without one it passes no traffic.
The instance is launched from the Debian 12 family.
A floating IP is associated with the instance's interface.
Nothing that exists is changed or deleted.
The agent reports the public address.
